Fetch multiple events by id in a single round-trip — for agents that

200.description: Current moneyline, spread, and total lines for the requested bookmaker(s), including in-play quotes while the event is underway. Default is Pinnacle only. Use bookmaker=all or a comma-separated list (e.g. bookmaker=fanduel,draftkings) to fetch multiple books. One book or all is 1 credit. Markets are grouped by type (h2h → moneyline, spreads → spread, totals → totals). Default view is main lines (is_main=true). Pass include_alts=true for alternate spread/total rungs. In-play responses omit books that have not quoted since kickoff. Final events include result (won/lost/push/void) graded from the pre-kickoff close (lumify_closing_odds), not the last in-play line. If no odds have been ingested for this event yet, returns 200 with available=false and is NOT charged (X-Credits-Used: 0). When bookmaker is omitted (default) and Pinnacle hasn't posted a line yet — common for the first/last games of a preseason slate — falls back to the best-covered other book instead of reporting no odds; the response then includes requested_bookmaker='pinnacle' and fallback_bookmaker=<book actually returned>. An explicit bookmaker=pinnacle request never falls back.

bookmaker.title: Bookmaker
bookmaker.description: Bookmaker for inlined odds and intelligence market prices. Defaults to pinnacle; 'all' or a comma-separated list for multiple books.

not_found.title: Not Found
not_found.description: Requested event_ids that don't exist. Never billed.

bet_type.title: Bet Type
bet_type.description: Canonical bet token, e.g. ML_HOME/ML_AWAY/ML_DRAW (soccer), ML_P1/ML_P2 (head-to-head sports), SPREAD_HOME/SPREAD_AWAY, OVER, UNDER.

player_role.title: Player Role
player_role.description: 'home'/'away' for team sports or 'p1'/'p2' for head-to-head sports. Null for match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW), which are not about either side.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: Player ID when this bet is about an individual player; null for team bets and match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW).

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: Team ID when this bet is about a team; null for individual-player bets and match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW). A draw is not a bet on either team, so ML_DRAW carries no team_id — safe to sum exposure by team_id across bets without double-counting the draw.

player_name.title: Player Name
player_name.description: Display name of the player or team this bet is about; null for match-level tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW). Duplicates `players[player_role].name` for convenience when flattening bets[].

market.title: Market
market.description: Market quote used for this bet: {price: American odds, line: handicap/total line or null for moneyline, book: bookmaker slug when known}. For predictive-framework sports `book` is always populated from the assessment; for legacy sports it may be omitted. Present for every sport.

computed_at.title: Computed At
computed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this bet's numbers last materially changed — not when they were last checked. The publisher re-runs on a schedule but only rewrites a row when the price, line, or probability moves beyond a tolerance, so an older `computed_at` means 'unchanged since', not 'stale'. Values legitimately differ between bets on the same event because each market moves independently.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Recommendation tier: 'very_high', 'strong', 'moderate', or 'avoid'. Null whenever `edge` is null — a tier ranks a bet against its price.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Not published. Event-level context chips live on the top-level `rationale` of IntelligenceResponse.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Published probability for this outcome, 0-1. Outcomes of the same market (e.g. ML_HOME + ML_DRAW + ML_AWAY) sum to 1. Present on the customer surface for MLB, soccer, and tennis.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: [lo, hi] band around `probability`, 0-1. Read it as 'how much evidence backs this number', not as a statistical confidence interval. A freshly-opened, unmoved line gets a wider band than a heavily-traded one. Thin evidence widens this band rather than removing the response. Present on the customer surface for MLB, soccer, and tennis.

p_model.title: P Model
p_model.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). Fitted model probability before blending with the market.

p_market.title: P Market
p_market.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). De-vigged market probability before blending; use `probability` / `fair_price` instead.

blend_w.title: Blend W
blend_w.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). Weight on the model when blending with the market.

fair_price.title: Fair Price
fair_price.description: American-odds fair price implied by `probability` — the vig-free line. Comparing it to `market.price` gives the bookmaker's margin on this side. Predictive-framework sports only.

edge.title: Edge
edge.description: Expected profit per 1 unit staked at `market.price`, i.e. `probability x decimal_odds - 1`. Positive means the price pays more than the probability justifies. Null when no model-backed edge is published (current MLB/soccer/tennis Stage 1). Present on the customer surface — null today, reserved for future recommend gating.

sufficiency.title: Sufficiency
sufficiency.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). Evidence strength 0-1 used internally to set interval width.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). Pipeline stage (`quant` / `full`).

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). Parameter-set identifier for traceability.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). Signed contributions to probability used in the assessment pipeline.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Internal — omitted from customer payloads (MLB/soccer/tennis). Qualitative-overlay agreement detail.

fair.title: Fair
fair.description: Sharp-consensus fair price for this outcome: {probability, books, n_books, is_consensus}. `probability` is distinct from `p_market` (the *priced* book's own de-vigged probability) and from `fair_price` (American odds implied by the published `probability`, above) — it is the sharp-book reference a cross-book price gap is measured against (MLS: Pinnacle / `SOCCER_SHARP_BOOKS`; MLB: Pinnacle+Circa / `MLB_SHARP_BOOKS`). `is_consensus` is false whenever `n_books` < 2. Populated for MLS and MLB; null for other leagues until their market plane is wired. Predictive-framework sports only.

edges_by_book.title: Edges By Book
edges_by_book.description: Price gap versus the sharp-reference fair probability (`fair.probability`), keyed by bookmaker — `fair.probability × decimal_odds − 1` at each book's posted price. A line-shopping metric: rank soft books by these gaps (largest gap = furthest above the sharp reference). Populated for MLS (retail soft books for Price — Edge archive stays FanDuel/Hard Rock) and MLB (retail soft books: DK/FD/BetMGM/Caesars/Bet365/Hard Rock/BetOnline — Price surface; Edge allowlist remains independence-cleared DK/FD only). Null for other leagues or markets with no soft quote. Predictive-framework sports only.

best.title: Best
best.description: Highest price-gap book across `edges_by_book`: {book, price, edge, quote_age_seconds}. Same metric as `edges_by_book`: price gap versus a de-vigged sharp reference. On MLB, `best_*` is Tier C / informational line-shopping even when the gap is positive (DK/FD ML and RL/totals are hard-null for Edge). Use `best.book`/`best.price` as the line-shopping target. `quote_age_seconds` is `best.book`'s posted-price age at publish — quotes older than 30 minutes are excluded. Populated for MLS and MLB; null otherwise or when `edges_by_book` is empty. Predictive-framework sports only.

ev.title: Ev
ev.description: **Beta.** Customer-facing expected-value estimate: {beta: true, book, price, ev_pct, kelly_fraction, quote_age_seconds, n_books}. `ev_pct` is the selected book's price gap × 100 (`fair.probability × decimal − 1`); `kelly_fraction` is the full-Kelly stake, capped at 1.0. Not a new measurement — re-packages the same sharp-fair price gap as `best`/`edges_by_book`. Main-line tokens (moneyline, spreads, totals; tennis totals unpublished). A single sharp book (n=1 Pinnacle) is a valid fair reference; soccer and tennis never have a two-book sharp consensus. Gaps ≤ 0 or above 25% (stale-line artifact) are dropped. When `best` is a suppressed MLB moneyline book (DraftKings/FanDuel proven null, or BetMGM/Bet365/BetOnline unscreened), the next eligible book in `edges_by_book` is used. Spreads/totals do not inherit that suppression. Unverified market-consensus estimate — see docs/internal/sports/PREDICTIVE_CLAIM_LADDER.md.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: The MCP tool / SDK call to estimate, e.g. 'get_event', 'batch_get_events', 'get_odds'. See GET /v1/estimate/tools for the full supported list.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Same arguments you'd pass to that tool/endpoint, e.g. {"event_id": 123, "include_odds": true}.

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: One or more planned calls to estimate in a single round-trip.

min_credits.description: Cheapest realistic outcome (e.g. requested data not yet available).

inprogress_since.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the first ingest that marked this event inprogress (first live tick). Null until then; stays set after final. Walkovers and events that never went live are usually null. Not the same as starts_at, which can be a session floor (especially tennis).

inprogress_since.title: Inprogress Since
inprogress_since.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the first ingest that marked this event inprogress (first live tick). Null until then; stays set after final. Walkovers and events that never went live are usually null. Not the same as starts_at, which can be a session floor (especially tennis).

id.title: Id
id.description: Namespaced driver id. Player-prop rows: typically `player.l10_rate` — the recent-form counting-stat rate that fed the Poisson step (also `player.season_rate` when L10 is too thin). Main-line rows would use a different namespace (e.g. a rating or surface split) once a main-line forecast model ships.

input.title: Input
input.description: Measured rate/rating behind this driver, in the units native to the underlying model (e.g. 0.27 runs/game, 7.4 strikeouts/start for the prop rate model). This is λ before the Poisson vs the posted line on prop rows.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Signed shift in `p_hit` versus a baseline case on the same line, in probability units. Positive / `direction=up` means this driver lifts the chosen outcome. 0.0 on yardage markets (league means are diluted by backups).

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Lumify event ID. Present on the daily slate (`GET /v1/intelligence/forecasts`); omitted on `GET /v1/events/{id}/intelligence` `forecasts[]` (the event is the path).

league.title: League
league.description: League slug, if any. Slate only.

commence_time.title: Commence Time
commence_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC scheduled start. Slate only.

home_team.title: Home Team
home_team.description: Home team display name. Slate only.

away_team.title: Away Team
away_team.description: Away team display name. Slate only.

player.title: Player
player.description: Player display name from the priced line. Null on main-line rows with no player attribution (`bet_type` is a match-level token like OVER/UNDER/ML_DRAW).

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: Lumify player ID. Bound by exact / Jr-stripped name match to the priced line. Null on main-line rows with no player attribution.

bet_type.title: Bet Type
bet_type.description: Main-line token when this row is a main-line forecast — `ML_P1`/`ML_P2`/`ML_HOME`/`ML_AWAY`/`ML_DRAW`, `SPREAD_P1`/`SPREAD_P2`/`SPREAD_HOME`/`SPREAD_AWAY`, or `OVER`/`UNDER` (same vocabulary as `bets[].bet_type` and `list_ev`). Null on player-prop rows — that's the discriminator between the two row shapes. Tennis sets `ML_P1`/`ML_P2` (moneyline, ranking Bradley-Terry), `SPREAD_P1`/`SPREAD_P2` (game handicap), and `OVER`/`UNDER` (total games — soft-book game-unit lines only, never Pinnacle's set-unit total); other sports are still null here.

player_role.title: Player Role
player_role.description: `home`/`away` for team sports or `p1`/`p2` for head-to-head sports, set only alongside a non-null `bet_type`. Null for player-prop rows and for match-level main-line tokens (OVER, UNDER, ML_DRAW).

market.title: Market
market.description: Player-prop rows: prop category — 1:1 counting stats. MLB: strikeouts_pitcher, hits, rbis, runs, strikeouts_batter, hits_allowed, earned_runs, outs_recorded. NFL/NCAAF: passing_yards, rushing_yards, receiving_yards, receptions. NBA/NCAAB: points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, threes_made. NHL: goals, hockey_assists, shots_on_goal. Main-line rows (when `bet_type` is set): the main-line family — `h2h`, `spreads`, or `totals`.

line.title: Line
line.description: Posted line the model was scored against. Player-prop and `totals` main-line rows: Over/Under number. `spreads` main-line rows: the spread number. Null on `h2h`/moneyline rows.

side.title: Side
side.description: Player-prop rows: `over` or `under` — the more likely side given the player's shrunken rate versus `line`. The model always picks one when the line is in range. Null on main-line rows — read the picked outcome from `bet_type` instead.

p_hit.title: P Hit
p_hit.description: Model probability (0–1) that the picked outcome (`side` on prop rows, `bet_type` on main-line rows) hits. Prop rows: built from the player's shrunken counting-stat rate (Poisson vs the posted Over/Under). Optional `research` may nudge a prop's `p_hit` by at most ±0.03; the chosen side stays the same.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: `[lo, hi]` stated band around `p_hit`. Wider when `sufficiency` is low (thin recent sample). A stated evidence band, not a statistical confidence interval.

sufficiency.title: Sufficiency
sufficiency.description: Evidence weight on 0–1: n / (n + 12), where n is the recent-form game count (typically L10). A player with 10 recent games has sufficiency ≈ 0.45 — about half the rate is player-observed, half prior. The wager still ships at any sufficiency; this field tells you how much of `p_hit` is earned from this player's own boxes.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Badge on this sport×market cell: `emerging`, `moderate`, `high`, or `informational`. v0 ships `emerging` for every wager; cells promote as a scored history accumulates.

conviction.title: Conviction
conviction.description: Board rank key on 0–1: |p_hit − 0.5| × 2 × sufficiency × research multiplier. A 0.76 call on a thin sample ranks below a 0.62 call on a long one. Highest conviction first on the daily slate.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: True when this wager is on the daily board (top conviction, up to 3 per event / 25 on the slate). On `GET /intelligence` the array includes both selected rows and the rest of the event catalog.

books.title: Books
books.description: American price for the picked outcome, keyed by bookmaker slug (e.g. `{draftkings: -453}`). Posted market price for the side/bet_type the model picked — use it to see what books are charging for that outcome.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: Signed contributions that moved `p_hit`. Read `input` as the measured rate/rating behind the pick and `effect` as how far it lifts (or lowers) the chosen outcome versus a baseline on the same line.

research.title: Research
research.description: Optional Deep Research overlay when the background job has written a row for a high-probability wager (`p_hit` ≥ 0.80): `{stance, conviction, note}`. `stance` is `validate` / `neutral` / `invalidate`. `note` is the wager-level why (the fact the model cannot see). Validate / invalidate rows always carry a note. Validate nudges `p_hit` up by at most 0.03 and lifts conviction; invalidate does the reverse. The chosen `side` stays the same. Null means read `p_hit` from the rate model alone — missing research is fail-open, not a 400.

bookmakers.title: Bookmakers
bookmakers.description: Per-bookmaker markets. Each outcome has outcome, price, point, is_main (true for the main line). In-play events keep updating and omit books that have not quoted since kickoff. Final events add result (won/lost/push/void) and close (the pre-kickoff graded point); tennis spreads/totals are the one gap — game-count isn't tracked, so only tennis moneyline grades. MLB, tennis, and soccer (MLS + big-five) mains also mirror fair_price and consensus from published assessments when the line still matches the board. Default /odds view is mains only; include_alts=true returns alternate spread/total rungs.

handedness.title: Handedness

height_cm.title: Height Cm
height_cm.description: Height in centimetres. Null when not ingested.

weight_kg.title: Weight Kg
weight_kg.description: Weight in kilograms. Null when not ingested.

rankings.description: Sport ranking block. Tennis: {singles, points} from ATP/WTA standings. Null for every other sport. Tennis /stats also exposes ranking / ranking_points on the tennis player block.

current_team_id.title: Current Team Id
current_team_id.description: Lumify team ID when the player is on a club roster. Null for tennis.

current_team_name.title: Current Team Name
current_team_name.description: Current team display name. Null for tennis.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Lumify media URL for the player headshot (https://lumify.ai/media/players/{sport}/{id}.{ext}). Null until the sport's headshot/enrichment job. Never a vendor CDN.

Player.title: Player
Player.description:
Directory identity for one player. Shared keys on every sport; null means
unknown, not 'wrong sport'. Sport-named metrics do not live here —
tennis ranking is ``rankings`` (null on every other sport). Tennis
``/stats`` also exposes ``ranking`` / ``ranking_points`` on the tennis
player block.

over.title: Over
over.description: American odds for the Over side at this book. Null if that book has no Over.

under.title: Under
under.description: American odds for the Under side at this book. Null if that book has no Under.

player.title: Player
player.description: Player display name as stored on the prop line.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: Lumify player id when the line's player name matches this event's roster or box (normalized full_name, then unique last-token fallback). Null when unmatched — the line is still returned.

market.title: Market
market.description: Prop market category, used as lumify_odds.market_key (e.g. passing_yards, points). Not the legacy player_* names.

line.title: Line
line.description: Main Over/Under number for this player + market.

current.title: Current
current.description: This-event counting stat from lumify_player_game_stats — a direct 1:1 box slug, a combo sum (e.g. points + rebounds), a weighted combo (e.g. total_bases = H + 2B + 2*3B + 3*HR), or a yes/no threshold (1.0/0.0, e.g. double-double). Null before the box lands, when unmatched, or when settleable is false.

pct_of_line.title: Pct Of Line
pct_of_line.description: current / line as a percent (one decimal). Null when current is null, or for yes/no threshold markets (double_double, triple_double) where current is a 1.0/0.0 flag and a ratio against the line is not meaningful.

settleable.title: Settleable
settleable.description: True when this market can be graded from this-event box counts (1:1 slug, combo sum, weighted combo, or yes/no threshold). False when the line is returned but not graded.

result.title: Result
result.description: in_progress while the event is not final. over / under / push once final and current is present. Null when settleable is false or we have no current to grade.

books.title: Books
books.description: Per-book Over/Under American prices at this exact line. Keys are odds slugs (pinnacle, fanduel, …). Books that posted a different number appear on a separate player_props row.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no player-prop mains have been ingested for this event. available:false is not charged.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport slug (nfl, ncaaf, nba, ncaab, nhl, or mlb on this endpoint).

status.title: Status
status.description: Event status: scheduled, inprogress, delayed, final, …

period.title: Period
period.description: Current period label from the live score snapshot (e.g. '3').

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: Game clock from the live score snapshot (e.g. '8:42').

player_props.title: Player Props
player_props.description: One row per (player, market, line). All books at that exact line are nested under books. Empty when available is false.

key.title: Key
key.description: Game-line market: h2h, spreads, or totals.

point.title: Point
point.description: Spread or total number. Null on h2h. Soccer 1X2 is three h2h outcomes with no point.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Sides at this market/point. Probabilities stay in (0, 1].

label.title: Label
label.description: Outcome name (team, Draw, Over, or Under).

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Implied probability in (0, 1]. Never American odds. Fanatics uses Nadex probability; Kalshi uses yes_ask_dollars; Polymarket uses outcomePrices.

contract_id.title: Contract Id
contract_id.description: Venue contract id: Nadex symbol, Kalshi ticker, or Polymarket condition id. Null when the source omitted one.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: Venue slug: fanaticsmarkets, kalshi, or polymarket.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Human venue name (Fanatics Markets, Kalshi, Polymarket).

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Game-line contracts for this venue. Empty when none ingested.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no prediction-market rows have been ingested for this event. available:false is not charged.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport slug (nfl, ncaaf, nba, nhl, mlb, soccer, or tennis).

venues.title: Venues
venues.description: One block per venue that has at least one game-line contract. Empty when available is false. Not sportsbooks — do not treat as GET /odds bookmakers.

available.title: Available
available.description: false when no splits have been ingested (or sport unsupported). available:false is not charged.

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent splits ingest for this event; null when available is false.

consensus.title: Consensus
consensus.description: Cross-bookmaker averages per market/side (moneyline/spread/total → home/away/over/under → bets_pct, handle_pct, optional price/line).

bookmakers.title: Bookmakers
bookmakers.description: Per-bookmaker breakdown. Each item: {bookmaker: odds slug (e.g. draftkings), name, moneyline, spread, total}. Bookmaker keys match /odds (not upstream short keys like dk).

window.title: Window
window.description: Max trailing meetings considered (see `windows.head_to_head`).

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.description: Most-recent-first past meetings between these two teams, up to `window`.

home_goals.title: Home Goals
home_goals.description: Goals scored by this event's home team in that past meeting.

away_goals.title: Away Goals
away_goals.description: Goals scored by this event's away team in that past meeting.

avg_goals_per_team.title: Avg Goals Per Team
avg_goals_per_team.description: League-wide average goals scored per team per game this season, used as the baseline the /intelligence layer compares each team's attack/defense against. Null before enough club-season games exist.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no lineup has been ingested yet for this side.

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: When this lineup was captured from the source, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

formation_place.title: Formation Place
formation_place.description: Slot index within the formation, when the source provides one.

window.title: Window
window.description: Which rolling window this block covers: 'l5' (see `window_size` for the fixed game count) or 'season' (an intentionally variable-length window — see `games` for how many games it actually covers for this team).

window_size.title: Window Size
window_size.description: Fixed sample depth for this window, only present when the window has one (e.g. 5 for 'l5'). Omitted for 'season', since season length varies by team — use `games` instead.

games.title: Games
games.description: Games with box-score data included in this average.

shots_on_target_for.title: Shots On Target For
shots_on_target_for.description: Avg. shots on target taken per game.

shots_on_target_against.title: Shots On Target Against
shots_on_target_against.description: Avg. shots on target conceded per game.

yellow_cards.title: Yellow Cards
yellow_cards.description: Avg. yellow cards received per game.

red_cards.title: Red Cards
red_cards.description: Avg. red cards received per game.

passes.title: Passes
passes.description: Avg. total passes per game (see pass_accuracy_pct for completion rate).

tackles.title: Tackles
tackles.description: Avg. total tackles per game (total tackles, not effective tackles).

blocked_shots.title: Blocked Shots
blocked_shots.description: Avg. shots blocked by this team per game.

assists.title: Assists
assists.description: Avg. team assists per game, summed from per-player goalAssists (the ingested team box has no team-level assists field).

save_rate.title: Save Rate
save_rate.description: Saves / shots on target faced across the window (not an average of per-game rates).

field_games.title: Field Games
field_games.description: Per-field sample size, keyed by the metric names above (including Phase 1C offsides/tackles/interceptions/blocked_shots/assists). `games` is how many games are in this window overall, but an individual field can have a smaller count when a source's box score omits that stat for some fixtures — lets agents tell 'averaged over all N games' apart from 'averaged over fewer'. Derived `save_rate` is the one exception that also appears here (joint saves + SoT faced coverage).

window.title: Window
window.description: Number of trailing completed games this form line covers.

goals_scored.title: Goals Scored
goals_scored.description: Goals this team scored in each game, same order as `results`.

goals_conceded.title: Goals Conceded
goals_conceded.description: Goals this team conceded in each game, same order as `results`.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when either team hasn't resolved for this fixture yet — every other field is omitted in that case and the call isn't billed.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: 'club' or 'world_cup'. Determines the shape of `teams.*.team_strength`, `teams.*.venue`, and whether `teams.*.sos` is populated.

neutral_site.title: Neutral Site
neutral_site.description: Whether this fixture is at a neutral venue. Informational here — not used in any of this endpoint's own aggregates, but factored into home-advantage scoring on GET /v1/events/{id}/intelligence.

window.title: Window
window.description: Number of trailing opponents this strength-of-schedule average covers.

avg_opp_ppg.title: Avg Opp Ppg
avg_opp_ppg.description: Average points-per-game of the opponents faced in `window`.

avg_opp_rank.title: Avg Opp Rank
avg_opp_rank.description: Average league-table rank of the opponents faced in `window`.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Lumify media URL for the team logo (e.g. https://lumify.ai/media/teams/soccer/855.png). Null until the logo ingest job has published the asset. Never a vendor CDN or raw GCS URL.

rest_days.title: Rest Days
rest_days.description: Days since this team's previous completed game.

rates_l5.description: Boxscore rate averages over the trailing 5 games.

rates_season.description: Boxscore rate averages over the current season/edition.

team_strength.title: Team Strength
team_strength.description: Club fixtures: {source: 'league_table_ppg', ppg, games, points, w, d, l, gf, ga, gd, rank} from the current league table.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: Club fixtures: {source: 'home_away_ppg_split', home_ppg, home_games, away_ppg, away_games}.

sos.description: Strength of schedule (avg. opponent PPG/rank over recent games). Null until enough league games exist.

recent_form.title: Recent Form
recent_form.description: Trailing games covered by each team's `recent_form`.

rates_l5.title: Rates L5
rates_l5.description: Trailing games covered by each team's `rates_l5`.

rates_season.title: Rates Season
rates_season.description: Always the literal string 'season' — a deliberately variable-length window (see each team's `rates_season.games`), unlike the fixed integer windows above.

head_to_head.title: Head To Head
head_to_head.description: Trailing meetings between these two teams considered for `head_to_head`.

sos.title: Sos
sos.description: Trailing opponents covered by each team's `sos`.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Lumify media URL for the team logo (e.g. https://lumify.ai/media/teams/mlb/70.png). Null until the logo ingest job has published the asset. Never a vendor CDN or raw GCS URL.

team.title: Team
team.description: Team display name (home or away participant).

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: Lumify team id for this side. Null only if the participant has no team row.

market.title: Market
market.description: Always 'team_total' today — this team's full-game points/goals Over/Under.

line.title: Line
line.description: Main Over/Under number for this team's score.

current.title: Current
current.description: This-event team score from lumify_participants.score. Null before kickoff or when the score is not numeric.

pct_of_line.title: Pct Of Line
pct_of_line.description: current / line as a percent (one decimal). Null when current is null.

settleable.title: Settleable
settleable.description: True — team totals grade from the same participant score /odds uses.

result.title: Result
result.description: in_progress while the event is not final. over / under / push once final and current is present. Null when current is missing.

books.title: Books
books.description: Per-book Over/Under American prices at this exact line. Keys are odds slugs (pinnacle, …).

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no team-total mains have been ingested for this event. available:false is not charged.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport slug (nfl, ncaaf, mlb, or soccer).

status.title: Status
status.description: Event status: scheduled, inprogress, delayed, final, …

period.title: Period
period.description: Current period label from the live score snapshot (e.g. '3').

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: Game clock from the live score snapshot (e.g. '8:42').

team_props.title: Team Props
team_props.description: One row per (team, line). All books at that exact line are nested under books. Empty when available is false.

source.title: Source
source.description: Always 'tennis_api' — career aggregates persisted by stats_ingest_tennis from our Stage-2 tennis data provider.

window.title: Window
window.description: Always 'career' — persisted career match-stats (not a trailing L10).

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: UTC timestamp when these rates were last persisted, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

hold_pct.title: Hold Pct
hold_pct.description: Career service-hold rate (0–1) from persisted serve game counts.

break_pts_converted.title: Break Pts Converted
break_pts_converted.description: Career break-point conversion rate (0–1) on return.

break_pts_saved.title: Break Pts Saved
break_pts_saved.description: Career break-point save rate (0–1) on serve when available.

first_serve_pct.title: First Serve Pct
first_serve_pct.description: Career first-serve-in rate (0–1) when the vendor exposes counts.

first_serve_won.title: First Serve Won
first_serve_won.description: Career first-serve points won rate (0–1) when available.

second_serve_won.title: Second Serve Won
second_serve_won.description: Career second-serve points won rate (0–1) when available.

aces.title: Aces
aces.description: Career ace count when present; null when the source does not expose aces on match-stats for this player.

double_faults.title: Double Faults
double_faults.description: Career double-fault count when present; null when the vendor does not expose double faults on match-stats for this player.

source.title: Source
source.description: Always 'tennis_api' — persisted surface-summary from our Stage-2 tennis data provider.

window_years.title: Window Years
window_years.description: Trailing calendar years of surface W/L included (currently 3).

surface.title: Surface
surface.description: Match competition surface slug this block is filtered to (hard/clay/grass/indoor_hard/carpet).

wins.title: Wins
wins.description: Wins on this surface in the window.

losses.title: Losses
losses.description: Losses on this surface in the window.

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: UTC timestamp when surface W/L was last persisted, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

window.title: Window
window.description: Trailing completed singles matches considered.

results.title: Results
results.description: Most-recent-first W/L results from ingested match history (no draws). Counts only status final/complete — walkovers are excluded (no games played); retirements count (status final, result_type retired).

sets_for.title: Sets For
sets_for.description: Sets won by this player in each form match (aligned with results when scores exist).

sets_against.title: Sets Against
sets_against.description: Sets won by the opponent in each form match (aligned with results when scores exist).

surface.title: Surface
surface.description: Present on surface_form only — the competition surface this window is filtered to.

window.title: Window
window.description: Max trailing meetings considered (see windows.head_to_head).

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.description: Most-recent-first prior singles meetings between these two players (status final/complete only — walkovers excluded; retirements included).

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of meetings returned in meetings.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Lumify event ID of the past meeting.

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: UTC start time of that meeting, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

winner_role.title: Winner Role
winner_role.description: 'player_1' or 'player_2' relative to *this* fixture's player ids (not the historical event's role labels).

sets_won.description: Sets won by this fixture's player_1 / player_2 in that meeting.

round.title: Round
round.description: Draw round label as ingested (e.g. 'Round of 16', 'Quarterfinal', 'Semifinal', 'Final') — not abbreviated codes like 'R16'.

court.title: Court
court.description: Named court within the venue when known. Not currently populated by ingest (effectively always null).

result_type.title: Result Type
result_type.description: How the match ended when final: regulation/retired; walkovers never went live.

rest_days.title: Rest Days
rest_days.description: Days since this player's previous completed singles match (any tour). Anchored on status final/complete only — walkovers do not reset rest; retirements do.

recent_form.description: Trailing singles results across all surfaces (walkovers excluded; retirements included — see TennisStatsForm).

surface_form.description: Trailing singles results filtered to this match's competition surface (walkovers excluded; retirements included — see TennisStatsForm).

record.description: Wins/losses over the tour_lookback window in our DB (walkovers excluded; retirements included).

career_rates.description: Stage-2 career serve/return rates from persisted match-stats. Null when stats_ingest_tennis has not yet written usable rows for this player.

career_surface.description: Stage-2 trailing surface W/L on this match's competition surface (persisted surface-summary, last windows.career_surface_years). Null when no matches on that surface in the window or ingest has not run.

source.title: Source
source.description: Always 'tour_lookback' — wins/losses from our DB over lookback_days (not a vendor season table).

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: Calendar days of lookback used for this record.

wins.title: Wins
wins.description: Singles wins in the lookback window (status final/complete only; walkovers excluded, retirements count).

losses.title: Losses
losses.description: Singles losses in the lookback window (status final/complete only; walkovers excluded, retirements count).

games.title: Games
games.description: Matches counted (wins + losses). Walkovers are not played matches and are excluded; retirements are included.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when draw_type is not exactly 'singles' (doubles and qualifying are out of scope for Stage-1/Stage-2) or either player_id is unresolved — every other field is omitted in that case and the call isn't billed.

draw_type.title: Draw Type
draw_type.description: Event draw format. Always 'singles' when available is true. draw_type values other than 'singles' (including 'doubles' and 'qualifying') return available:false — consistent with the rest of the tennis predictive stack.

sets_won.description: Match sets won by each side.

winner_role.title: Winner Role
winner_role.description: 'player_1' or 'player_2' when decided; null for upcoming/live undecided matches.

sets.title: Sets
sets.description: Per-set game scores from lumify_period_scores (period_type='set'), ordered by period_num.

player_1_games.title: Player 1 Games
player_1_games.description: Games won by player_1 in this set.

player_2_games.title: Player 2 Games
player_2_games.description: Games won by player_2 in this set.

tiebreak_score.title: Tiebreak Score
tiebreak_score.description: Tiebreak points for this set when present on the source row. Not currently populated by ingest (effectively always null).

recent_form.title: Recent Form
recent_form.description: Trailing matches covered by each player's recent_form.

surface_form.title: Surface Form
surface_form.description: Trailing matches covered by each player's surface_form.

record_lookback_days.title: Record Lookback Days
record_lookback_days.description: Calendar days covered by each player's record (tour_lookback).

career_surface_years.title: Career Surface Years
career_surface_years.description: Trailing calendar years covered by each player's career_surface (Stage-2).

cf-turnstile-response.title: Cf-Turnstile-Response
cf-turnstile-response.description: Cloudflare Turnstile response token from the widget on /docs/ai.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: Returned only on create — store it to verify Lumify-Signature.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: Returned only on create — store it to verify Lumify-Signature.
